item.title: SC Refuses Bail to Umar Khalid, Sharjeel Imam in Delhi Riots Conspiracy Case
item.description: GUWAHATI: The Supreme Court on January 5 refused to grant bail to Umar Khalid and Sharjeel Imam in the Delhi riots “larger conspiracy” case, holding that the materials on record disclosed a prima facie case against them under the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act, 1967. However, the Court granted bail to other accused—Gulfisha Fatima, Meeran Haider, Shifa Ur Rehman, Mohd. Saleem Khan and Shadab Ahmed. item.title: Guwahati Sees First Use of POEM for Swallowing Disorder
item.description: Apollo Hospitals Guwahati has successfully performed Per Oral Endoscopic Myotomy (POEM), an advanced endoscopic procedure used in the treatment of Achalasia Cardia, a swallowing disorder. This is the first reported instance of the procedure being carried out in Northeast India, according to the hospital. item.title: 5.1 Magnitude Earthquake Strikes Assam in Early Hours
item.description: GUWAHATI: An earthquake of magnitude 5.1 struck Assam’s Morigaon district in the early hours of Monday, sending tremors across the region. item.description: GUWAHATI: With Assembly elections expected in the next few months, confusion persists among several voters in Guwahati over their Legislative Assembly Constituencies (LACs), even years after delimitation was carried out. A few residents say they remain unsure about which constituency they fall under, raising concerns about voter awareness ahead of the polls. item.title: 15-Year-Old Detained in Pathankot for Alleged ISI Espionage Links
item.description: GUWAHATI: Pathankot police have arrested a 15-year-old boy for allegedly spying for Pakistan, accusing him of sharing sensitive information related to national security with handlers linked to the Inter-Services Intelligence (ISI).
